+name: 'Drupal docs navigation link'
+description: 'Adds a "Drupal docs" link to the content section of the Navigation administrative sidebar.'
+type: Administration
+install:
+  - navigation
+config:
+  actions:
+    navigation.block_layout:
+      # Appends a navigation link block to the existing Navigation layout
+      # rather than replacing it. The delta is the position within the
+      # content region: 0 is Shortcuts and 1 is the Content menu, so 2 places
+      # the link directly after the Content menu and before Administration.
+      addNavigationBlock:
+        delta: 2
+        configuration:
+          id: navigation_link
+          label: 'Drupal docs'
+          label_display: '0'
+          provider: navigation
+          context_mapping: {}
+          title: 'Drupal docs'
+          uri: 'https://www.drupal.org/docs'
+          icon_class: ''
+        additional: {}

@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_autoform\Form;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Form\FormBase;
+use Drupal\Core\Form\FormStateInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\State\StateInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Stores a note in state and shows when it was last saved.
+ */
+class BenchAutoformForm extends FormBase {
+
+  public function __construct(
+    protected readonly StateInterface $state,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function getFormId(): string {
+    return 'bench_autoform';
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function buildForm(array $form, FormStateInterface $form_state): array {
+    $last = $this->state->get('bench_autoform.last', 'never');
+    $form['last_saved'] = [
+      '#markup' => $this->t('Last saved: @value', ['@value' => $last]),
+    ];
+    $form['note'] = [
+      '#type' => 'textfield',
+      '#title' => $this->t('Note'),
+      '#required' => TRUE,
+    ];
+    $form['actions'] = ['#type' => 'actions'];
+    $form['actions']['submit'] = [
+      '#type' => 'submit',
+      '#value' => $this->t('Save'),
+    ];
+    return $form;
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * {@inheritdoc}
+   */
+  public function submitForm(array &$form, FormStateInterface $form_state): void {
+    $this->state->set('bench_autoform.last', $form_state->getValue('note'));
+    $this->messenger()->addStatus($this->t('Note saved.'));
+  }
+
+}
